thread:
maria: Quick heads-up: HF->Redwood conversion failing for rift-model-v2 on long-context tests. Seeing 3 separate quirks: rope_scaling object getting dropped, sliding_window treated differently, and num_key_value_heads mismatch. Also chat template introduced a system token that shifted positions.

aj: can you paste the offending config and an example tokenization? :eyes: 

maria: pasted HF config as plain key/value lines:
model_type = gpt
num_attention_heads = 32
num_key_value_heads = 16
max_position_embeddings = 8192
rope_scaling = type=dynamic, factor=1.2
sliding_window = 256
special_tokens = bos=<|bos|>, system=<|system|>

kevin: aha 294 we currently map rope_scaling only if it's a float, not an object. That means factor gets ignored and default scaling 1.0 used -> alignment drift at long seq lengths. :thinking: 

ina: and sliding_window: HF's repo uses it as an integer chunk size for KV windowing. Our conversion assumed a boolean feature flag and flipped it off. So we effectively removed chunking and KV cache behavior changed.

maria: right. Also noticed tokenization: the chat template inserts <|system|> at the start; tokenizer adds that as one token but our runtime sometimes reserves one slot for BOS and then applies max_position_embeddings-1 logic, so sequences hit the max earlier (off-by-one). Long-context evals fail.

aj: repro steps for me:
1) convert HF -> redwood config with current mapper
2) run long_context_smoke (1000tok prompt + system token)
3) compare perplexity to HF baseline
I see a jump in ppl ~18% when mapper drops rope_scaling and sliding_window.

model-onboard-bot: Conversion check: rift-model-v2 failed eval: long-context perplexity +18% vs HF baseline. See test logs: /ci/logs/rift-v2/long-context-2026-03-21.log

kevin: proposed conversion rules:
- accept rope_scaling when specified as an object/dict; if present extract numeric factor and map to runtime. If no factor, fall back but emit warning.
- preserve sliding_window numeric values as sliding_window_size on Redwood side (do not coerce to boolean).
- if num_key_value_heads exists, set num_kv_heads explicitly instead of assuming num_attention_heads equality.
- validate max_position_embeddings against tokenizer.encode length of a canonical chat template and emit warning if borderline.

ina: also add unit tests: tokenization offset test to catch BOS/system-token off-by-one, and a quantitative smoke eval for quantized builds to catch regressions early.

aj: I'll open a PR with mapper fixes + 3 tests (tokenizer offset, rope_scaling object parsing, sliding_window numeric preservation). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboard/pull/421

maria: please also add a user-facing conversion warning message in the console/docs so integrators see "conversion preserved sliding_window numeric chunking; verify long-context evals" or similar.

aj: will add an explicit warning line and CI gating for long-context smoke.

ina: tiny nit: some older HF checkpoints use num_key_value_heads = null  - mapper should treat null as missing and fall back to a conservative value (floor(num_attention_heads/2)) but also log it.

kevin: good point. Also for rope_scaling: HF accepts shapes like type=linear,scale=1.1 - map all known keys robustly and add tests for unknown shape.

model-onboard-bot: Note: quantized rift-model-v2 build queued; holding until conversion-fixes merged. CI tag: qbuild-1872

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: conv-mapper-fix -> staging at 2026-03-22T04:00Z

maria: thanks : action items:
- aj: PR + tests (assigned)
- kevin: add conversion warnings + docs snippet
- ina: add tokenizer offset unit and smoke eval check
- ops: hold quantized release until staging passes

aj: on it. I'll add a small repro script in examples/convert/ to show the HF config -> converted JSON diff.

ina: can we also instrument the optimizer to log if effective sequence length (after template tokens) exceeds 95% of max_position_embeddings? Might prevent accidental truncation in prod.

kevin: yeah add a runtime WARNING and a fallback to chunking if sliding_window present.

maria: perfect. thanks everyone. Let's track in the PR and close once staging passes. :thumbsup:
